purpose: Declare who owns what in a CYNIC-governed system, and the boundary governance may never cross. Exists because two reference systems died at exactly this boundary: ELIZA Labs, where governance power was not provable to participants and a class action consumed the treasury; Steem, where capital's veto was removed and a fork replaced settlement.

P1_incorruptible_claim.description: Claims that no aggregate of governance weight may extinguish, dilute, or transfer. Recognised, not earned.

P2_delegated_authority.description: Authority derived from observed contribution. Recomputed, never stored. Forfeited on defection.
P2_delegated_authority.revocable: on ceasing contribution, or on defection

rights.name: material_claim
rights.note: Steem and ELIZA both overwrote this. A supply expansion of 1.1B to 11B and a 23.6M token seizure are the two measured forms of the same violation.

rights.name: right_of_exit
rights.note: Departure is the only counterweight to governance that the governed party can exercise unfalsifiably and at no cost. Without it, a community is held rather than governed.

rights.name: governance_weight
rights.note: Derived, never a field. The same property that forbids self-grant also forbids capture by a fork, which begins with zero observed history and therefore earns zero weight.

rights.name: obligation_attached
rights.note: Tenure and stake live here, not in R-C. Seniority raises the cost of defection and never the vote count; conflating the two produces a gerontocracy.

invariants.statement: No aggregate of governance weight may extinguish, dilute, or transfer a material claim R-A. There is no weight at which this becomes permissible.
Any actor may exit and remove its own material claim without admission, without cause, and without any other actor's cooperation.
Governance weight is a pure function of observed contribution. No actor may assign, grant, sell, or inherit it. It is recomputed, never read from a field.
Revocation transfers an obligation to a named successor that accepts it with observable proof. Revocation may never extinguish an obligation.
No quantity of material claim is convertible into governance weight. The two are not commensurable.
Tenure may modify obligation R-D. Tenure is never an input to governance weight R-C.
Contribution with no observable consumption by a third party has zero weight. Activity is not value.

asymmetries.statement: Governance weight R-C cannot be acquired with material claim R-A.
asymmetries.prevents: governance power that is not provable to participants
asymmetries.reference_failure: ELIZA Labs, 2026-04-20 class action: governance represented as autonomous while insiders retained actual control

asymmetries.statement: Material claim R-A and right of exit R-B cannot be overridden by any sum of R-C and R-D.
asymmetries.reference_failure: Steem hard fork 0.23, 2020-03: 23.6M STEEM seized from 64 accounts under a contribution-justified mechanism

discriminator.question: Does the holder of the largest material share hold a vote over a decision that affects another actor's material claim?
discriminator.coverage_note: The rule is declared and the check is missing. governance_ownership_declares_its_unenforced_checks asserts this null is honestly null rather than absent.

weight_model.formula: weight(i, Δ) = Σ_Δ retention(i, Δ) / cost(i, Δ) · exp(-λ·(now - Δ)), capped at saturation s_i

retention.definition: share of consumers of the output over Δ, over lifetime consumers

decay.reason_null: no measured corpus exists; an uncalibrated constant is a belief and this contract does not ship beliefs as numbers

weight_model.separation_rule: Flow and stock of the same quantity must never govern the same power. A single scalar mixing capital and contribution, or mixing retention and tenure, is forbidden.
weight_model.falsifier: A working system with stored, self-assignable weight that does not fall to capture.

provenance_carries_capacity.rule: A created artifact carries a verifiable, non-transferable authorship claim, and authority over that artifact follows its author.
provenance_carries_capacity.consequence: Identity enters the system through work. No KYC is required for entry.

treasury_constraint.rule: No treasury may be the sole legal defense of a permissionless system.
treasury_constraint.reasoning: A public balance sheet is a legal target. The mitigation is structural bounding, not a promise.
treasury_constraint.precedent: Futard.io — escrowed treasuries with monthly spending limits; MetaDAO is the only futarchy observed operating at scale

explicit_non_goals: naming any token, community, market, or economic instrument
any on-chain settlement — append-only PoH yields contradiction, not falsification
the economic policy split between buyback, community proposals, and infrastructure maintenance
forbidden_interactions: a vote count mixing retention and tenure
a vote count mixing capital and contribution in one scalar
any revocation path that extinguishes rather than transfers
any schema where governance weight is a stored field

violations.statement: A governance path exists by which a material claim R-A can be altered without the claimant's consent.
violations.remediation: Remove the path. There is no weight threshold at which it is acceptable.

violations.statement: Governance weight is stored in a field, or is assignable by an actor.
violations.remediation: Make the field derived, or delete it.

violations.statement: Exit requires the consent, admission, or approval of another actor.
violations.remediation: Exit must be a local action.

known_exclusions: DISC-01 has no executable check. The constitutional side is declared, not enforced.

R-C derives to unknown in practice: ChatTrace.prompt_tokens and gen_tokens are Option<u64> = None because no production TraceSink is wired. Until that is connected, no weight is derivable and the honest state is unknown, not zero.

BusClaimStore.consume_action has no caller, so recorded consumed budgets are uniformly zero across active claims. A field that is always one value is indistinguishable from a field that does not exist.

promotion_requires: DISC-01 enforced by an executable check, not by declaration
weight derived from a live observation rather than null
OWN-001..003 either impossible or covered by a red test that is deliberately kept red
